narratives.Overview:
## Parent
Part of AppSec scan tracker **#2904** (2026-07-29). Remediation **Batch D** (quarantine completeness).

## Finding
| | |
| --- | --- |
| **ID** | `cache-quarantine-06` |
| **Severity** | **Low** |
| **Dimension** | `cache-quarantine` |
| **File** | [`packages/core/src/intake/issue-ingest.ts`](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/master/packages/core/src/intake/issue-ingest.ts) |

## Issue
`buildIssueVbrief` scans title/body/comments/plan-item titles but copies **label names unchanged** into `narratives.Labels` and `plan.tags` — unscanned agent-authoritative fields.

## Remediation
1. Run label strings through `scanUntrustedIngestText` (hard-fail credentials; fence/omit injection-shaped labels) before writing Labels/tags.
2. Tests for credential-shaped / injection-shaped labels.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Labels follow same hard-fail/fence contract as titles
- [ ] Tests assert label scan
- [ ] CHANGELOG if needed

## Refs
- Tracker #2904
- Batch D sibling: cache-quarantine-03
